program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16, 10, 20),        # diff pair efficiency
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),     # diff pair L (flicker area)
    "itail": (30e-6, 10e-6, 60e-6),
    "i7":    (160e-6, 60e-6, 350e-6),
    "Lp":    (0.6, 0.4, 1.5),     # PMOS load / 2nd-stage L (matched for zero systematic offset)
    "gmidp": (10, 7, 13),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),     # NMOS current-source L
    "cc":    (1.5e-12, 0.5e-12, 2.5e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.6, 0.8, 4.0),     # Rz = rzk / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail, i7 = p["itail"], p["i7"]
    i1 = itail / 2

    # diff pair (source near 0.2 V -> body effect)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS mirror load and second-stage PMOS: same L and gm/Id -> Vsg matched
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=1.1)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i7, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias mirrors: low Vdsat for tail headroom
    gmidn = 12
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], itail, vds=0.2)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], i7, vds=0.9)

    cc = p["cc"]
    rz = p["rzk"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: ibias sunk by a diode-connected nfet
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # differential pair: vinp drives the mirror output side (x) -> vout non-inverting from vinp
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "x", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    cx = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * cc / (2 * PI * (cc * (cl + cx) + cl * cx))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * cc * (1.0 / m7.gm - rz))   # LHP if rz > 1/gm7 (negative value)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir))
    pm += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(z))) if z < 0 else -math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i7)
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = 2 * kT4 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt(th) * 2.0   # rough 1/f allowance at 1 kHz
    slew = min(itail / cc, i7 / (cc + cl))

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "noise_1k": noise, "slew": slew}
